text: In accordance with Toronto Atmospheric Fund By-law Number 1, the Board may appoint one or more days in each year for regular meetings of the Board a time named; no further notice of the regular meetings need be given. City Council on November 25 and 26, 2020 approved the 2021 schedule of meetings for City Council and its Committees. The schedule of meetings for Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund have been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid meetings on days of cultural or religious significance. The following meetings of the Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund have been scheduled for the remainder of 2021. The date in April will be TAF’s Annual General Meeting. Monday, April 26 at 3:00 p.m. Friday, July 9 at 9:00 a.m. Friday, November 5 at 9:00 a.m.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund received the item for information.
